result.headline: Throttle cut to 0 at t=49.81 s with no event; attitude tracking degraded from 55.7 s.
result.explanation: Propulsion command went to 0% and stayed there to the end, and motor output ch2 followed it. Pitch and roll control degraded about 6 s later, probably as a consequence. The recording does not show who or what cut the throttle.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT propulsion.throttle was varying, then held 0 from t=49.81 s to the end of the recording (12.441 s, 33 samples)
evidence.shows: Throttle command froze at 0 with no mode change or event in the window; the events call returned only two start-up messages.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[2]] was varying, then held 1100 from t=50.228 s to the end of the recording (11.794 s, 36 samples)
evidence.shows: The propulsion output followed the throttle command (correlation 0.997, lag 0 s), so the cut is upstream of the output channel.

evidence.quote: SHIFT vehicle.attitude[pitch] followed its setpoint worse for good from t=55.707 s: typical |error| 1.467 before, 18.256 after deg (15x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Pitch tracking degraded about 6 s after the throttle cut. Roll degraded too (line 87). Altitude fell from 54.174 m to 31.512 m over the same period.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=1.249 s controller.event[mavros: Battery] mavros: Battery: WARN: Low voltage
evidence.shows: A low-voltage warning came at start-up. It may be benign, but it is the only power-related hint, and nothing later in the recording follows it up.

checked.check: Which signal left baseline first around 40-62 s, and whether tracking changed when the throttle dropped
checked.result: Setpoints and the throttle ramp (to 68%) moved first, then the throttle dropped to 0 at 49.81 s. Attitude tracking was unchanged at 49.8 s, with ratios 1.07, 0.79 and 0.39.
checked.about: Propulsion cut as the earliest hard fault

checked.result: Pitch tracking error went from 1.927 to 18.256 deg and roll from 1.158 to 7.253 deg. Setpoints changed first (yaw at 55.182 s, roll at 55.895 s, pitch at 56.475 s), then ch1 and the attitudes.
checked.about: Attitude loss as a consequence of the throttle cut or a manoeuvre
ESC or actuator output fault; ch2 simply obeyed the command

checked.result: Large changes in velocity and yaw, but this is a manoeuvre with tracking unchanged (ratios 1.89, 1.37 and 0.95), not a fault onset.

effects.why: Motor output only mirrors the throttle command; its change reflects the command, not the fault.

effects.quote: SHIFT vehicle.altitude[relative] changed level for good at t=57.126 s: median 50.143 before, 39.909 after m (6x its variation before)
effects.why: Altitude loss is consistent with zero thrust.

events.what: Start-up low voltage warning and sensor health error
events.why: At start-up; battery warning may matter but nothing later in the recording follows it up.

events.what: Throttle ramps up then drops to 0 and holds
events.why: No event explains it; earliest hard fault.

events.what: Motor output ch2 goes to 1100 and holds
Pitch/roll tracking degraded and altitude falls from 55.7 s

events.why: Constant for the whole recording; probably not wired or logged.

result.lesson: No earlier closed case matched this signature.
result.reuse_when: Fixed-wing or VTOL UAV on MAVROS autopilot where throttle goes to 0 with no mode event and the motor output channel follows at lag 0.
